note: Setting-agnostic special-resource layer. Mechanical ancestor: Protocol 7 VAMs. Flavor supports modern occult and archaic fantasy; cyberpunk skins can remap later.

features.name: Fast Draw
features.summary: Ready or stow one accessible one-handed weapon for 0 AP, once per round.
features.detail: When your hands are free enough to reach it, you may ready or stow one accessible one-handed weapon (blade, wand, sidearm, tool) without spending AP. Once per round.

features.name: Threat Focus
features.summary: Mark one visible threat; add d4 to your first defense against them until your next turn.
features.detail: Choose a visible tracked threat. Until your next turn begins, add a Feature d4 to your first appropriate active defense against that threat.

features.name: Snap Strike
features.summary: After you Aim, your next trained attack this turn costs 0 AP (once per turn).
features.detail: Works with melee or ranged training your world allows. Aim first, then strike without spending the usual attack AP.

features.name: Warded Step
features.summary: Once per turn, move 30 feet as a guarded step that ignores ordinary difficult footing fictionally justified by your craft.
features.detail: Your table decides whether this is a charm, a practiced ghost-step, or a flick of will. It does not ignore solid walls or lethal hazards without GM buy-in.

features.name: Second Sight
features.summary: Add Feature d4 to Perception or Investigation when reading auras, residues, or hidden occult signs.
features.detail: Declare when you open your senses. The die is a named Feature source, not Advantage.

features.name: Binding Word
features.summary: Once per session, force a narrow social or occult promise the fiction can support; opposed Will if contested.
features.detail: Creates leverage and obligation, not mind control. Modern tables may call it a geas, a contract, or a blood oath.

features.name: Cold Read
features.summary: Add Feature d4 to Influence or Deception when reading a mark in conversation.
features.detail: Requires a live social exchange. Does not auto-succeed; it improves your pool.

features.name: Open Doors
features.summary: Once per session, establish a plausible introduction, invitation, or soft access.
features.detail: Creates opportunity. The GM may narrow claims that exceed your fiction.

features.name: Cover Story
features.summary: Spend 1 AP to lock a short cover identity; allies who heard it may echo it with Advantage once.
features.detail: Works for courtly lies, club aliases, or undercover work. Crumbles if facts contradict it loudly.

features.name: Field Kit
features.summary: Add Feature d4 to Medicine, Engineering, or Security when you have a minute and ordinary tools.
features.detail: Tools may be a med satchel, a ritual kit, or a multitool — same chassis.

features.name: Jury-Rig
features.summary: Once per session, make a damaged device, lock, or ward function for one short scene.
features.detail: Temporary. The GM sets the failure fiction when the scene ends.

features.name: Iron Gut
features.summary: Add Feature d4 to Fortitude against poison, sickness, or occult contamination.
features.detail: Named Feature die. Does not stack with Advantage unless both are separately earned.

features.name: Hard to Kill
features.summary: When you would drop to 0 HP, remain at 1 HP once per session and become Exposed until you recover.
features.detail: Playtest wording: you stay up, bloodied and obvious. Table may rename Exposed to their condition list.

features.name: Ghost Trail
features.summary: Add Feature d4 to Stealth or Survival when covering tracks or vanishing into terrain/crowd.
features.detail: Urban alleys and deep woods both count.
